introduction: Missouri weatherization improves efficiency in eligible homes. Local agencies handle applications, audits and installation.
description: Missouri weatherization improves efficiency in eligible homes. Local agencies handle applications, audits and installation.

sections.who: The local agency verifies eligibility using income documentation and applicable rules. Confirm renter and property conditions.
sections.get: An energy audit identifies work producing suitable energy savings. It is not a general renovation grant.
sections.docs:
• Income records.
  • Energy bills.
  • Homeownership or landlord information requested.
sections.apply:
1. Find your agency

    Use DNR’s local agency directory.

  2. Complete intake

    Submit the agency’s forms and income proof.

  3. Arrange the audit

    After eligibility review, an auditor assesses the home.
sections.after: A quality-control inspector checks completed work. Ask about waiting lists.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Missouri weatherization process; Local agencies. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Do I apply directly to a contractor?
Start with the designated local agency.
The agency uses an energy audit.
